headword: {正三角形|せいさんかくけい}

definitions.explanation: A triangle in which all three sides are of equal length and, equivalently, all three interior angles are equal at 60°. The most symmetric of the triangle types and a foundational figure in elementary and middle-school geometry.

examples.japanese: {正三角形|せいさんかくけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
{正三角形|せいさんかくけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内角|ないかく}→内角：28901_naikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すべて{60度|ろくじゅうど}だ。
examples.english: All interior angles of an equilateral triangle are 60 degrees.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンパス→コンパス：05595_konpasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{定規|じょうぎ}→定規：04280_jougi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧{正三角形|せいさんかくけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作図|さくず}→作図：23809_sakuzu⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: With a compass and a ruler, you can easily construct an equilateral triangle.

examples.japanese: {一辺|いっぺん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かれば→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧、{正三角形|せいさんかくけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧や⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: If you know the length of one side, you can find the area and height of an equilateral triangle using a formula.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧ (regular; correct, used as a geometric prefix meaning 'regular' as in ⟦{正方形|せいほうけい}→正方形：05438_seihoukei⟧ 'square'), ⟦{三角|さんかく}→三角：04177_sankaku⟧ (triangle), and {形|けい} (shape). The ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧ prefix indicates that all sides and angles are equal, paralleling 'regular polygon' in English.

USAGE:
A core term in elementary and middle-school mathematics. The reading せいさんかくけい is the standard textbook reading, but せいさん⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦っけ→っけ：10739_kke⟧い (with sokuon) is also widely heard and is often listed as an alternative reading. Often appears alongside {直角三角形|ちょっかくさんかくけい} (right triangle) and {二等辺三角形|にとうへんさんかくけい} (isosceles triangle) when classifying triangles. The ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧〜{形|けい} pattern extends to ⟦{正方形|せいほうけい}→正方形：05438_seihoukei⟧ (regular square) and {正多角形|せいたかくけい} (regular polygon).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正三角形|せいさんかくけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to draw an equilateral triangle
- {正三角形|せいさんかくけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作図|さくず}→作図：23809_sakuzu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to construct an equilateral triangle (in geometry)
- {正三角形|せいさんかくけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧: area of an equilateral triangle
- {正三角形|せいさんかくけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一辺|いっぺん}: one side of an equilateral triangle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{三角形|さんかくけい}→三角形：05436_sankakukei⟧: triangle — the general term
- {二等辺三角形|にとうへんさんかくけい}: isosceles triangle — two sides equal, the next-most-symmetric type
- {直角三角形|ちょっかくさんかくけい}: right triangle — has one 90° angle
- ⟦{正方形|せいほうけい}→正方形：05438_seihoukei⟧: square (regular quadrilateral) — built from the same ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧〜{形|けい} pattern
- {正多角形|せいたかくけい}: regular polygon — the broader category to which {正三角形|せいさんかくけい} belongs
